headline: Fresh Base Clashes Erupt Across Kuura Strand and Nevish Line
war_summary: Fresh territorial clashes flared across the northern and island theaters over the past three hours, marked by a sharp revival in Kuura Strand where five base transitions unfolded. Fighting also abruptly reignited along Nevish Line, logging four base exchanges right up to the morning wire, while Pari Peak recorded three further shifts. Weathered Expanse remained intensely contested, registering three additional structural turnovers alongside more than eight hundred casualties in the latest two-hour span. Linn of Mercy posted two more base changes centered around Outwich Ranch, while frontline movement halted entirely in Stlican Shelf and Marban Hollow. Meanwhile, purely attritional combat escalated across Callahan's Passage, Stonecradle, Olavi's Wake, and Farranac Coast, where opposing forces traded heavy gunfire and absorbed hundreds of fresh casualties without forcing immediate alterations to local base control.
